Cc: security@pioneerhealth.com
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up — remaining artifacts and KMS questions

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the completed SIG spreadsheet. Quick follow-ups from our security team:
- We need the current KMS rotation runbook (steps + owner + rotation window).
- A retention matrix mapping Redwood data stores to retention periods and redaction rules.
- A screenshot or architecture fragment showing where session artifacts (session logs, ephemeral caches) are stored and how they are archived.

Could you share Drive links for these by EOD Friday PST? Also please note any gaps (e.g., non-applicable items) so we can close the checklist on our side.

Best,
Elena
Security Analyst, Pioneer Health

[This thread originally started with the SIG spreadsheet on 2027-10-28 — thanks for the quick turnaround on answers so far.]

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick note on scope: the retention matrix will cover hosted API data paths and our Dedicated offering; Private (on-prem) customers have their own retention controls and are marked NA where relevant.

I'll coordinate the Drive delivery with Markus (infra) and Monica (compliance). If there's anything particularly time-sensitive in the checklist, flag the row and I'll prioritize.

Target: consolidated Drive folder + short manifest by Friday 11/5.

Regards,

Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Action: build Drive folder for Pioneer Health — KMS runbook + retention matrix

Hi Markus / Monica,

Pioneer Health needs three artifacts by EOD Friday PST:
1) KMS rotation runbook (pdf) — include rotation cadence, key owners, step-by-step rekey process, emergency rollback.
2) Retention matrix (spreadsheet) — per-store retention, redaction rules, TTLs, owner.
3) Session architecture screenshot — where session caches and archived blobs live, with links to logs and lifecycle jobs.

Markus — can you draft the runbook PDF and export the session architecture diagram? I attached the template we use (runbook-template.docx).
Monica — can you validate retention values and owner names, and confirm any entries that should be NA for Private deployments.

I'll assemble the Drive folder, generate a short manifest, and share links to Elena + security@pioneerhealth.com.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.

Priya

Attachments: runbook-template.docx

From: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 14:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Action: build Drive folder for Pioneer Health — KMS runbook + retention matrix

Priya / Monica —

Thanks. I created the runbook and exported the diagram. Key notes:
- KMS rotation cadence: quarterly automatic rotation for hosted policy keys; manual rotation for customer-managed keys with documented approval flow.
- Emergency key rollback: documented steps + contact list.
- Diagram shows sessions written to ephemeral Redis-like cache (managed in GCP/Azure) and archived to object store with lifecycle rule of 90 days then archive tier.

I uploaded the artifacts to a draft folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-kms-rotation-PI01 (view only).
Files uploaded: kms-rotation-runbook.pdf, session-arch-diagram.png, retention-matrix.csv (draft).

Markus
Infra Lead, Redwood Inference

Hi Elena —

Thanks for your patience. We've consolidated the requested artifacts into a single read-only Drive folder and added a manifest that maps each file to the SIG questions:
Drive folder (view only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-kms-rotation-PI01
Manifest (attached in Drive): 2027-11-05-pioneer-manifest.csv
Direct files:
- kms-rotation-runbook.pdf (owner: Markus Klein)
- retention-matrix.csv (owner: Monica Patel)
- session-arch-diagram.png (owner: Markus Klein)

Notes / known gaps:
- Private deployments: retention matrix marks several cells NA — these are customer-controlled. We'll include a short note in the manifest explaining where customers must supply values.
- For customer-managed KMS keys: we included the manual rotation checklist but cannot perform rotation for customer keys — Pioneer team will need to schedule with their KMS owner.

Attachments in thread: kms-rotation-runbook.pdf, retention-matrix.csv, session-arch-diagram.png (all available in the Drive folder).

If you need screenshots of the actual console sessions (redacted) for audit evidence, Markus can export a sanitized sequence — let us know the timeframe and retention rows you want validated.
